name: The Peninsula Paris
insider_take: Parisian palace meets modern luxury in this impeccably restored 19th-century Haussmann building, where every detail whispers understated elegance.
whats_special: The Peninsula Paris features the largest hotel suites in the city and boasts a spectacular rooftop restaurant, L'Oiseau Blanc, offering 360-degree views of iconic landmarks including the Eiffel Tower and Arc de Triomphe. The hotel's fleet of Rolls-Royce vehicles provides the ultimate Parisian arrival experience.
pro_tip: Book the rooftop spa's outdoor terrace treatment during sunset for breathtaking views while you unwind – it's the only rooftop spa terrace in central Paris.
dont_miss: The hotel's location puts you steps from the Arc de Triomphe and Champs-Élysées, while the nearby Avenue Kléber offers exclusive boutique shopping. The concierge can arrange private after-hours tours of the Louvre, accessible within a 10-minute drive.
pros: Prime location near Arc de Triomphe and Champs-Élysées
Exceptional personalized service with high staff-to-guest ratio
Luxurious spa and rooftop terrace with panoramic city views
Peninsula Pen Club Program exclusive benefits and recognition
